hotels.name: Atlantis, The Palm
hotels.note: The default big-occasion family staycation - waterpark and aquarium access baked into the stay keeps kids busy all weekend.

hotels.name: Atlantis The Royal
hotels.note: Booked for milestone celebrations and show-off weekends; residents go for the restaurants and the rooftop pool scene.

hotels.name: Burj Al Arab Jumeirah
hotels.note: A once-in-a-while bucket-list stay for residents - anniversaries and big birthdays rather than a routine weekend.

hotels.name: Jumeirah Beach Hotel
keyFeatures: private beach facing Burj Al Arab
hotels.note: A long-running family favourite - the included Wild Wadi access makes the maths work for parents.

hotels.name: Jumeirah Al Naseem
keyFeatures: access to Souk Madinat and resort waterways
hotels.note: The most modern of the Madinat resorts; residents like the beach-club feel plus the whole Madinat estate on foot or by abra.

hotels.name: Jumeirah Al Qasr
hotels.note: Old-Arabia grandeur with the full Madinat dining village attached - a reliable special-weekend pick.

hotels.name: Address Beach Resort
keyFeatures: record-setting rooftop infinity pool on the 77th floor
walkable to The Walk and Bluewaters
hotels.note: The rooftop infinity pool is the draw - one of the most photographed staycation bookings in Dubai.

hotels.name: Rixos The Palm Dubai Hotel & Suites
hotels.note: Residents book it when they want a switch-off, everything-included weekend without leaving the Palm.

hotels.name: FIVE Palm Jumeirah
keyFeatures: The Penthouse and beach club nightlife
hotels.note: The go-to for a loud, social weekend - pool parties and nightlife on site rather than a quiet escape.

hotels.name: Fairmont The Palm
hotels.note: A steady family favourite with frequent resident rates and dining-credit staycation deals.

hotels.name: Anantara The Palm Dubai Resort
hotels.note: The closest thing to a Maldives overwater stay without flying - popular for anniversaries and babymoons.

hotels.name: Sofitel Dubai The Palm
hotels.note: Large family rooms and a relaxed pace make it a repeat booking for families with young kids.

hotels.name: One&Only Royal Mirage
hotels.note: Understated old-school luxury; residents pick it for grown-up, low-key weekends over flashier newcomers.

hotels.name: Le Méridien Mina Seyahi Beach Resort & Waterpark
hotels.note: The included waterpark and big beach make it one of the strongest pure-family staycations near the Marina.

hotels.name: The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai
hotels.note: A quiet, low-rise pocket amid high-rise JBR - regulars value the garden feel and service consistency.

hotels.name: Banyan Tree Dubai
hotels.note: The former Caesars Palace reborn - residents like the sanctuary feel minutes from the Marina.

hotels.name: Address Downtown
keyFeatures: Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain views
hotels.note: The classic Downtown city-break - fountain-view rooms are the point, especially around NYE and event weekends.

hotels.name: JA The Resort
hotels.note: A self-contained weekend of activities away from the city crush - repeatedly cited as one of Dubai's best-value family staycations.

hotels.name: Bab Al Shams, A Rare Finds Desert Resort
hotels.note: Dubai's classic desert escape, fully refurbished in 2023 - close enough for a one-night reset.

hotels.name: Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa
keyFeatures: inside a conservation reserve with free-roaming oryx
hotels.note: The special-occasion desert stay - private pool villas and wildlife at sunrise justify the splurge for residents.

hotels.name: Lapita, Dubai Parks and Resorts, Autograph Collection
hotels.area: Dubai Parks and Resorts, Jebel Ali
keyFeatures: walking distance to Motiongate and Legoland
hotels.note: The practical base for a theme-park weekend - park-inclusive packages are its whole appeal for families.

hotels.name: Rove La Mer Beach
hotels.note: Rare budget-friendly beachfront in Jumeirah - young residents book it for cheap-and-cheerful beach weekends.

hotels.name: Centara Mirage Beach Resort Dubai
hotels.note: Consistently among the best value family staycations - a compact waterpark holiday at a mid-market price.

hotels.name: Riu Dubai
hotels.note: Dubai's straightforward all-in option - one price covers food and drinks, which makes budgeting a staycation easy.

hotels.name: JA Hatta Fort Hotel
keyFeatures: close to Hatta kayaking and mountain-bike trails
hotels.note: The cooler-climate weekend - residents pair it with Hatta Dam kayaking and hiking in winter.

hotels.name: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Abu Dhabi
keyFeatures: signature Palace Cappuccino and afternoon tea
hotels.note: The capital's trophy stay - residents book it for landmark occasions and the famously large grounds.

hotels.name: The St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort, Abu Dhabi
keyFeatures: next to Saadiyat Beach Golf Club
hotels.note: White-sand Saadiyat beach with a genuinely good kids club - a regular for family weekends from Dubai and Abu Dhabi alike.

hotels.name: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island
hotels.note: The UAE's best-known premium all-inclusive - families book it to stop thinking about bills for a weekend.

hotels.name: Jumeirah Saadiyat Island Resort
hotels.note: Modern, airy and right on one of the country's best natural beaches - dolphins and turtles are a genuine possibility.

hotels.name: Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas
hotels.note: The quiet-luxury choice on Saadiyat - picked by residents who want calm rather than a scene.

hotels.name: Saadiyat Rotana Resort & Villas
hotels.note: Saadiyat sand at a friendlier price point than its five-star neighbours - a solid repeat family booking.

hotels.name: W Abu Dhabi - Yas Island
keyFeatures: built over the F1 Yas Marina Circuit
hotels.note: The Grand Prix hotel - booked out for race weekend and popular year-round for theme-park-plus-nightlife breaks.

hotels.name: Hilton Abu Dhabi Yas Island
keyFeatures: Yas Bay waterfront and beach access
walkable to Yas Bay promenade nightlife
hotels.note: A well-priced Yas base with the promenade's restaurants on the doorstep and parks a shuttle away.

hotels.name: The WB Abu Dhabi, Curio Collection by Hilton
hotels.note: Kids-first by design - park-inclusive packages make it the easiest theme-park weekend in the country.

hotels.name: Crowne Plaza Abu Dhabi Yas Island
keyFeatures: shared Yas Plaza pools and beach shuttle
hotels.note: One of the Yas Plaza value cluster - residents use it as a cheap sleep between theme-park days.

hotels.name: Fairmont Bab Al Bahr
keyFeatures: views of Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
hotels.note: The mosque-view photo from the pool is the signature; handy midpoint location for Dubai residents visiting the capital.

hotels.name: Shangri-La Qaryat Al Beri, Abu Dhabi
hotels.area: Qaryat Al Beri, Khor Al Maqta
hotels.note: Canal abras, a souk and mosque views give it more sense of place than most city resorts - a steady favourite.

hotels.name: Conrad Abu Dhabi Etihad Towers
hotels.note: City sophistication with a real beach attached - popular with couples doing a capital weekend.

hotels.name: Qasr Al Sarab Desert Resort by Anantara
hotels.note: The UAE's most dramatic desert stay - a 90-minute drive past Liwa that residents treat as a proper escape, not a stopover.

hotels.name: Al Wathba, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa
hotels.note: A desert reset only 40 minutes from the city - the spa circuit is the reason most residents go.

hotels.name: Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah
hotels.note: RAK's flagship classic - close enough to Dubai for one night, grand enough to feel like a real holiday.

hotels.name: The Ritz-Carlton Ras Al Khaimah, Al Wadi Desert
keyFeatures: oryx and gazelle in the reserve
hotels.note: Private-pool desert villas an hour from Dubai - a firm anniversary and proposal favourite.

hotels.name: Rixos Bab Al Bahr
hotels.note: The weekend residents book to eat, drink and switch off - RAK's benchmark all-inclusive.

hotels.name: Mövenpick Resort Al Marjan Island
hotels.note: A newer Marjan family option that wins repeat bookings on its splash park and kids-stay-free deals.

hotels.name: Hampton by Hilton Marjan Island
keyFeatures: kids club and water play area
one of the region's biggest Hamptons
hotels.note: Probably the best-known cheap beach staycation in the UAE - basic rooms, big pools, tiny prices.

hotels.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Resort & Spa Marjan Island
hotels.note: A workhorse resort that regularly tops value-staycation lists - big, busy and reliably discounted.

hotels.name: The Cove Rotana Resort
hotels.note: The terraced-village look photographs like Santorini - a long-standing resident favourite for short breaks.

hotels.name: Anantara Mina Al Arab Ras Al Khaimah Resort
keyFeatures: overwater villas on a protected lagoon
hotels.note: Opened 2024 and instantly the Maldives-substitute of the north - overwater villas without the flight.

hotels.name: InterContinental Fujairah Resort
keyFeatures: beachfront on the Gulf of Oman
hotels.note: The east coast's polished all-rounder - clear-water swimming and diving that the Gulf side can't offer.

hotels.name: Address Beach Resort Fujairah
keyFeatures: direct beach on the Indian Ocean coast
hotels.note: Brought Dubai-level polish to Al Aqah - the current top-end pick for an east-coast weekend.

hotels.name: Le Méridien Al Aqah Beach Resort
hotels.note: The east coast's long-serving family stalwart - generations of UAE families have done this exact weekend.

hotels.name: Fairmont Fujairah Beach Resort
keyFeatures: beach and marina setting below the Hajar mountains
hotels.note: Tucked up by Dibba with easy snorkelling trips - quieter than the Al Aqah strip.

hotels.name: Sandy Beach Hotel & Resort
hotels.note: Dated but loved - residents keep coming back for the best easy snorkelling in the country.

hotels.name: The Chedi Al Bait, Sharjah
hotels.note: A genuinely different staycation - old-Sharjah courtyards and quiet luxury instead of a beach scene.

hotels.name: Sheraton Sharjah Beach Resort & Spa
hotels.note: Sharjah's main full-service beach resort - alcohol-free, which many family bookers actively prefer.

hotels.name: Coral Beach Resort Sharjah
hotels.note: A dependable budget beach weekend minutes from Dubai's northern suburbs.

hotels.name: Mysk Kingfisher Retreat
keyFeatures: luxury tents with private plunge pools
hotels.note: Barefoot-luxury glamping on an empty Kalba beach - one of the UAE's most distinctive nights away.

hotels.name: Fairmont Ajman
hotels.note: Five-star beach comfort at Ajman prices, 30-40 minutes from most of Dubai - an easy sell for families.

hotels.name: The Ajman Saray, a Luxury Collection Resort
hotels.note: The Marriott Luxury Collection option in Ajman - residents use it for a quietly premium beach weekend without Dubai crowds.

hotels.name: Ajman Hotel by Blazon Hotels
hotels.note: The old Kempinski grande dame of Ajman - keeps a loyal following for its gardens and unhurried pace.

hotels.name: Vida Beach Resort Umm Al Quwain
hotels.note: The first big lifestyle-brand resort in UAQ - a quiet, design-led alternative to the RAK crowd.

hotels.name: Barracuda Beach Resort
hotels.area: Khor Al Beidah, Umm Al Quwain
hotels.note: A UAE institution best known for its adjacent retail store - the chalets serve cheap, unfussy weekends by the water.
